candidates.name: AU NOMO
candidates.reason: Listed on AU's current card list and product page with an Apply button. FD-backed (secured) card: joining fee 199 one time, no annual fee from year 2, 0.99% forex, 2 points per ₹100 retail (1 point = ₹0.25 per the page), 5,000 point cycle cap, quarterly milestone, 2 domestic and 2 railway lounge visits a quarter. Network not stated anywhere AU publishes (left null). KFS v1.9 and MITC v2.23 disagree on the cash limit (50% vs 70%); the page FAQ and the 10 Apr 2026 lounge T&C disagree on the lounge spend (20,000 vs 50,000).

candidates.name: AU Xcite

Earn: 15 points per ₹100 on dining, movies, grocery and departmental stores; 3 per ₹100 base; 1 per ₹100 on utility, telecom and insurance; 2X on days 1 to 5 of each month; 25,000 point cycle cap (CMA). candidates.name: AU Xcite ACE
candidates.reason: Sold (listed, KFS annual fee 749). candidates.name: AU Xcite Ultra
candidates.reason: Listed, KFS annual fee 749, waiver at 2,00,000. candidates.name: AU InstaPay RuPay
candidates.reason: AU's own product page says the card "is exclusively available to our existing Credit cardholders" and "Currently applicable for the select base only"; it is virtual only and shares the credit limit of an existing primary card. It is still on the card list and in the KFS (lifetime free, cash advance not applicable), so a person may choose to catalogue it as invite_only. Not drafted under brief rule 4. Reward on the page: 1% cashback on dining, pharmacy, departmental, grocery and supermarket MCCs, minimum transaction ₹200, capped ₹100 per statement cycle; the KFS forex table does not list InstaPay.

candidates.name: AU Kosmo
candidates.reason: Sold (listed, lifetime free per KFS). AU publishes no reward rate: the page says only "Earn Kiwi rewards" on UPI scan and pay and on eCom, POS and contactless, and the Cardmember Agreement has no Kosmo or Kiwi section. The Kiwi app terms are a partner document and were not used. Written with no reward rules so the importer skips it. Network not named (UPI linking points to RuPay; a template popup also lists Visa offers).

candidates.name: AU Zaggle
candidates.reason: Sold (listed, lifetime free). Two networks are issued and named by AU (Visa and RuPay, Cardmember Agreement 23.33 and the page), so network is resolved as dual. Point value stated: 1 Zagg Coin = 1 Reward Point = ₹0.25. Held because AU states rates as "X% Zagg Coins" (RuPay: 4% and 8% on zagg.money UPI, 2% elsewhere; Visa: 8% contactless, 4% e-commerce, 2% other) and never defines how many coins one percent is per ₹100, so no value can be computed without guessing. Cap 2,000 points a cycle, ₹500 minimum transaction. Written with no reward rules; structure kept in notes.
